actions_policy: pin every action to full commit SHA
no pull_request_target execution of untrusted PR code
boundary: attestation/provenance is not a security certification
important_limits: In-process plugin permissions are not sandboxing
SHA-pinned Actions still require update monitoring
No secrets/OIDC publish authority in untrusted PR workflows
supply_chain: dependency review on PR with high severity gate
GitHub build provenance attestations at release
PyPI PEP 740 attestations only if/when PyPI gate executes
